Direction and purpose of address, data and control buses.

questions.prompt: Which register stores the address of the next instruction?
Which bus transfers instructions and data between CPU and RAM?
Give the abbreviation of the memory address register.
Give the abbreviation of the current instruction register.
Describe the different roles of MAR and MDR during a memory read.
questions.model_answer: MAR holds the address of the memory location to read. MDR holds the data or instruction read from that location.
questions.grading_criterion:
1: MAR holds the address of the memory location to read.
1: MDR holds the data or instruction read from that location.
questions.student_guidance:
Identify what points to the memory location being read.
Identify what temporarily holds the value returned from that location.

questions.prompt: Explain the purpose of the address bus and the control bus when fetching data from memory.
questions.model_answer: The address bus carries the location to be accessed to memory. The control bus carries a memory-read control signal.
questions.grading_criterion:
1: The address bus carries the location to be accessed to memory.
1: The control bus carries a memory-read control signal.
questions.student_guidance:
Think about how memory learns which location the CPU wants.
Think about which signal tells memory to perform a read.
